summary: Justin Seagren fell while descending Blanca Peak in the Blue Lakes area, just past the Alamosa County line in Huerfano County; Alamosa Volunteer SAR flown in by Flight for Life with technical gear spotted his body from the air with no signs of life; Canon City Helitack helped recover the body (~300-ft haul to the ridgeline near the 14,000-ft summit area), then flew it out by long-line extraction.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue + Flight for Life + Canon City Helitack
notes: Recorded at the distress-call date: article says AVSAR was called 'Wednesday, Sept. 7' (2022-09-07 was a Wednesday, weekday-verified); recovery by AVSAR + Flight for Life insertion + Canon City Helitack — two team members rappelled to the subject, packaged the body, hauled ~300 ft to the ridgeline between the Blanca summit area (~14,000 ft); helitack completed extraction by long line. County = Huerfano per the article ('just past the Alamosa County line'). Alamosa Citizen AVSAR-helipad story (opened run 805): the Seagren mission used multiple helicopters making multiple landings at the team-designated landing zone; official helipad talks with Alamosa County Road & Bridge began after this mission. Run 827 merge: AVSAR mission post (parent-opened, full-string verified absent).
